$description: Console LIGHT theme, emitted to the :root block of src/styles/tokens.css by tokens/build.mjs. `palette` holds the website's B2 values, so the console and olivares.ai wear one brand (scripts/check-brand-parity.mjs pins the shared subset against the emitted file): four neutrals (frame, canvas, surface, raised), three text tones, the single brand orange #f08000 in its roles, and the status colours with their soft fills. Every text token holds at least 4.5:1 and every control boundary, focus ring and selection border at least 3:1 on every surface, including under the selection and hover fills and on the soft fills (500 pairs over both themes, pinned by src/styles/tokens.test.ts). `tools` holds the four tool data colours, `depth` the two neutral shadows, `roles` the names the components use.

frame.$description: Window frame: the sidebar and the gutters around the sheet.

canvas.$description: The sheet: the rounded work area.

surface.$description: Cards, the composer and list groups.

hover.$description: Pointer hover fill. 4% so the orange as text (#a84f00) holds 4.5:1 on a hovered, selected row.

active.$description: Selection and pressed fill: the second surface step, solid.

line.$description: Hairline separator. Decorative only: it never carries information.

ctl-border.$description: Boundary of inputs, selects and switches: at least 3:1 on every surface.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind a modal dialog or sheet.

text-3.$description: Tertiary text: at least 4.5:1 on every surface, under the selection fill and on every soft fill.

accent.$description: The brand orange as a FILL: the one primary action, the selected row, running work.

accent-border.$description: Orange boundary and selection bar: at least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

warn.$description: Warning text and glyph. Olive in light (hue 54, 6.49:1 on the canvas), gold in dark: never the orange.

tools.$description: The four tool data colours, in a fixed order that is the tool, never its rank (dataviz validator, 2026-10-17, both themes). Orange is not a series colour: it marks the one thing that needs you. Light aqua is 2.74:1, so every series carries a direct label: identity is never colour alone.

tool-claude.$description: Claude Code, as a data series.

tool-gemini.$description: Gemini CLI, as a data series.

depth.$description: Depth: two neutral shadows, for what floats. No glow, blur or halo: depth is tone steps, one hairline and these two shadows.

shadow-pop.$description: Floating layers: dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

shadow-card.$description: Cards and panels: none. A panel that does not float carries no shadow.

roles.$description: The names the console components paint with today. Each alias is resolved at build time, so the generated file holds the palette value itself and one value lives in one place.

muted.$description: Solid well: the selection fill (`active`) painted on the canvas, as one opaque color, so text on it is measured like text under the selection fill.

accent-hover.$description: The primary action on hover: the orange at brightness 1.06, as the design renders it. Ink stays above 4.5:1.

accent-active.$description: The primary action while pressed. Ink stays above 4.5:1.

danger-solid.$description: Solid destructive fill (not part of the palette; kept at its measured value).

danger-solid-foreground.$description: Ink on the solid destructive fill.

confidence-attributed.$description: Access-graph confidence: attributed (a cool axis apart from status).

elevation.$description: The elevation steps the components use, mapped onto the two shadows of the design: cards on the lower three, popovers and dialogs on the upper two.
